assumptions.demo_gap: gross modal price difference only; no freight, fees or spoilage applied
assumptions.false_alarm_definition: flag day with no crash day in the same market within false_alarm_horizon_days
assumptions.harvest_cost_source: Rs 70 per 15 kg box, Kolar 2025, Outlook Business (CLAUDE.md Section 10); sourced
assumptions.lead_definition: days from the earliest flag within lead_window_days before an episode's first crash day; 0 = same day; null = no flag
assumptions.week_adjacency: ISO weeks w-1..w+1 with 52/53 adjacent to 1

demo_day.criteria: Kolar Jan-Apr 2025; 7 of last 7 days with price and arrivals for Kolar and the alternative; largest gross modal gap

mode_recommendation.rule: predictive only if arrival-ratio flags lead crash episodes by >= 2 days on most (>50%) scorable episodes and an alternative pays; else same_day (CLAUDE.md Sections 7, 17.2)

model.note: R, risk levels, flags and leads are model output from the Section 9 Step 1 rule on observed data.

xcorr_R_vs_forward_price_change.note: a glut signal that leads price would show clearly negative correlation; values near 0 or positive mean R does not lead price
